pipeline.asset: Ameluz (BF-200 ALA, aminolevulinic acid 10% topical gel) + RhodoLED/RhodoLED XL lamp PDT
pipeline.modality: Photodynamic therapy (topical photosensitizer + red-light device combination)
pipeline.target: Protoporphyrin IX accumulation in dysplastic skin cells; light-activated cytotoxicity
pipeline.license_origin: Acquired full US rights from Biofrontera Pharma (parent) effective Oct 20, 2025

indications.trial_design: Randomized vs placebo-PDT; primary endpoint = composite complete clinical + histological clearance of main target lesion at 12 weeks; results: 65.5% Ameluz-PDT vs 4.8% placebo-PDT
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting; sNDA submitted to FDA Nov 2025; PDUFA date Sept 28, 2026

indications.trial_name: Phase 3 trunk & extremities PDT (1-3 tubes Ameluz)
indications.trial_design: Field-directed PDT using RhodoLED lamp on extremities and neck/trunk
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting; last-patient-out Q3 2025; CSR expected Q2 2026; sNDA filing expected Q3 2026

indications.trial_design: Randomized 1h vs 3h incubation Ameluz-PDT vs vehicle-PDT
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting; LPO Q3 2025; Phase 2 data obtained Q1 2026; CSR expected Q3 2026

commercial_product.product: Ameluz + RhodoLED / RhodoLED XL Lamp PDT
approved_indications: Mild to moderate Actinic Keratosis on face and scalp (US, since 2016; sNDA Oct 2024 expanded to up to 3 tubes per treatment)
